shortDescription: Italy's biggest lender Intesa Sanpaolo MILSEDEX:I05808 on Saturday said it would increase by 25% the cash component of its takeover bid for Monte dei Paschi di Siena MIL:BMPS, and warned investors in the bank it would walk away if they backed a defence plan.
